name: Warfarin
description: Warfarin is an anticoagulant medication used to prevent blood clots. It works by inhibiting vitamin K epoxide reductase, which is critical for the synthesis of clotting factors.

name: Metformin
description: Metformin is an oral hypoglycemic agent primarily used to treat Type 2 Diabetes. It improves insulin sensitivity and decreases hepatic glucose production.

name: Lisinopril
description: Lisinopril is an ACE inhibitor used to treat hypertension and heart failure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, which lowers blood pressure.

name: Sertraline
description: Sertraline is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) used to treat major depression and anxiety disorders. It increases serotonin levels in the brain.

name: Ibuprofen
description: Ibuprofen is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) used to relieve pain, reduce inflammation, and lower fever. It works by inhibiting cyclooxygenase enzymes.

name: Aspirin
description: Aspirin is an NSAID that is widely used to relieve pain and reduce the risk of heart attacks. It irreversibly inhibits cyclooxygenase-1 and -2.

name: Methotrexate
description: Methotrexate is an antimetabolite and immunosuppressant used in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis and certain cancers. It inhibits dihydrofolate reductase.

name: Insulin
description: Insulin is a hormone used as a medication to control blood glucose levels in diabetes. It facilitates the uptake of glucose by tissues.

name: Atorvastatin
description: Atorvastatin is a statin medication used to lower cholesterol levels and reduce cardiovascular disease risk. It inhibits HMG-CoA reductase.

name: Omeprazole
description: Omeprazole is a proton pump inhibitor used to treat gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD). It reduces stomach acid production.

name: Clopidogrel
description: Clopidogrel is an antiplatelet medication used to prevent strokes and heart attacks. It works by inhibiting platelet aggregation.

name: Amoxicillin
description: Amoxicillin is an antibiotic used to treat various bacterial infections. It works by inhibiting cell wall synthesis in bacteria.

name: Prednisone
description: Prednisone is a corticosteroid used to treat inflammatory conditions and autoimmune diseases. It suppresses the immune response.

name: Levothyroxine
description: Levothyroxine is a synthetic thyroid hormone used to treat hypothyroidism. It restores normal levels of thyroid hormone in the body.

name: Gabapentin
description: Gabapentin is an anticonvulsant medication used to treat neuropathic pain and seizures. It modulates calcium channels to reduce excitability.

name: Type 2 Diabetes
description: Type 2 Diabetes is a chronic condition characterized by insulin resistance and high blood sugar levels. It can lead to serious health complications if not managed.

name: Hypertension
description: Hypertension, or high blood pressure, is a common condition that can lead to serious cardiovascular diseases if left untreated. It often requires ongoing management.

name: Rheumatoid Arthritis
description: Rheumatoid Arthritis is an autoimmune disorder that causes chronic inflammation of the joints. It can lead to joint damage and disability.

name: Major Depression
description: Major Depression is a severe mood disorder that affects how a person feels, thinks, and handles daily activities. It can significantly impair quality of life.

name: Atrial Fibrillation
description: Atrial Fibrillation is an irregular heartbeat that can lead to blood clots, stroke, and other heart-related complications. It often requires anticoagulation therapy.

name: Chronic Pain Syndrome
description: Chronic Pain Syndrome is a condition characterized by persistent pain lasting longer than 3 months. It can be associated with various underlying diseases.

name: Hypothyroidism
description: Hypothyroidism is a condition where the thyroid gland does not produce enough hormones, leading to symptoms like fatigue and weight gain. It can be managed with thyroid hormone replacement.

name: GERD
description: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) is a chronic digestive condition where stomach acid flows back into the esophagus, causing symptoms like heartburn. It often requires lifestyle changes and medication.

name: Heart Failure
description: Heart Failure is a serious condition where the heart cannot pump enough blood to meet the body's needs. It may require medications and lifestyle modifications.

name: Deep Vein Thrombosis
description: Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) is a condition where blood clots form in deep veins, typically in the legs. It can lead to serious complications such as pulmonary embolism.

name: Epilepsy
description: Epilepsy is a neurological disorder characterized by recurrent seizures. It can be managed with anticonvulsant medications.

name: Osteoarthritis
description: Osteoarthritis is a degenerative joint disease characterized by the breakdown of cartilage. It causes pain and stiffness, particularly in weight-bearing joints.

name: CYP2D6
description: CYP2D6 is a gene that encodes an enzyme involved in the metabolism of many drugs. Genetic variations can affect drug efficacy and safety.

name: VKORC1
description: VKORC1 is a gene encoding the vitamin K epoxide reductase enzyme, which is a target for anticoagulants like Warfarin. Variants influence Warfarin dosing.

name: ACE
description: ACE encodes angiotensin-converting enzyme, a key regulator of blood pressure. It is a target for antihypertensive drugs like Lisinopril.

name: AMPK
description: AMPK is a gene that encodes a protein involved in cellular energy homeostasis. It is implicated in metabolic disorders and is a target for diabetes drugs.

name: COX-2
description: COX-2 encodes an enzyme involved in inflammation and pain. It is a target for NSAIDs like Ibuprofen and Aspirin, which reduce pain and swelling.

name: TNF-alpha
description: TNF-alpha is a cytokine involved in systemic inflammation and is a target for drugs treating autoimmune diseases like Rheumatoid Arthritis.

name: SLC22A1
description: SLC22A1 encodes a transporter protein involved in drug uptake. Variants can impact the efficacy of certain medications, particularly in diabetes.

name: HLA-B
description: HLA-B is a gene that codes for a protein involved in the immune response. Certain alleles are associated with drug hypersensitivity reactions.

name: MTHFR
description: MTHFR encodes an enzyme involved in folate metabolism. Genetic variants can affect the metabolism of drugs like Methotrexate.

name: PCSK9
description: PCSK9 is a gene that encodes a protein involved in cholesterol metabolism. It is a target for cholesterol-lowering therapies.

name: Headache
description: Headache is a common symptom that can occur in various conditions, including migraines and tension-type headaches. It may require analgesic treatment.

name: Fatigue
description: Fatigue is a pervasive feeling of tiredness and lack of energy. It can accompany many diseases such as depression and hypothyroidism.

name: Nausea
description: Nausea is an unpleasant sensation often accompanied by the urge to vomit. It can be a side effect of medications or arise from gastrointestinal disorders.

name: Joint Pain
description: Joint pain is a common symptom in conditions like osteoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis. It can range from mild discomfort to severe pain.

name: Dizziness
description: Dizziness is a sensation of lightheadedness or unsteadiness. It can occur in various medical conditions, including vestibular disorders and dehydration.

name: Bleeding
description: Bleeding can occur from various sites in the body and can be a side effect of anticoagulant medications. It requires prompt medical attention.

name: Muscle Weakness
description: Muscle weakness is a reduction in strength that can be caused by neurological disorders, autoimmune diseases, or medication side effects.

name: Insomnia
description: Insomnia is a sleep disorder characterized by difficulty falling or staying asleep. It can be associated with depression and anxiety.

name: Shortness of Breath
description: Shortness of Breath is a sensation of not getting enough air and can be associated with conditions such as asthma, heart failure, and anxiety.

name: Swelling
description: Swelling is an abnormal enlargement of a body part, often due to inflammation or fluid retention. It can occur in various medical conditions.

name: Weight Gain
description: Weight Gain is an increase in body weight that can be caused by various factors including medication side effects, metabolic disorders, and lifestyle changes.

name: Stomach Pain
description: Stomach Pain is a common symptom that can arise from various gastrointestinal issues, including GERD and ulcers. It may require treatment depending on the cause.

name: Renin-Angiotensin System
description: The Renin-Angiotensin System is a hormone system that regulates blood pressure and fluid balance. It is a key target for antihypertensive drugs.

name: Coagulation Cascade
description: The Coagulation Cascade is a complex series of events that lead to blood clotting. It is crucial for hemostasis and is targeted by anticoagulants.

name: Serotonin Pathway
description: The Serotonin Pathway is involved in mood regulation and is a key target for antidepressants like SSRIs. It impacts various physiological functions.

name: Inflammatory Response Pathway
description: The Inflammatory Response Pathway is a biological process that involves the immune system's response to injury or infection. It is targeted by anti-inflammatory drugs.

name: Insulin Signaling Pathway
description: The Insulin Signaling Pathway regulates glucose homeostasis and is crucial in diabetes management. It involves insulin receptor signaling and downstream effects.

name: Thyroid Hormone Pathway
description: The Thyroid Hormone Pathway regulates metabolism, growth, and development. It is vital for maintaining energy balance in the body.

name: Cholesterol Metabolism Pathway
description: The Cholesterol Metabolism Pathway is critical for lipid homeostasis and is targeted by statins for cholesterol-lowering therapies.

name: Pain Signaling Pathway
description: The Pain Signaling Pathway involves the transmission of pain signals and their modulation. It is a target for analgesic medications.
